pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Start Native Host v1 as a separate post-Core stage without modifying the frozen CAP Core v1 head.

Stack identity:

- frozen Core dependency: `ca6923924952a2f457dc12e3604c97034a8fae23` (#175)
- fresh Stage Research commit: `37f2833ed588ea45ac506f739b1b72a9ef910c6b`
- implementation starts only after the refreshed research decision **NARROW**

PR #170 remains a historical research record from the earlier #169 base; this PR refreshes the decision against #172-#175 rather than building production on the stale branch.

## Stage boundary

```text
ordinary ChatGPT
 -> CAP semantic capability
 -> frozen CAP Core v1
      authorization / WorkingState / reconciliation / verification / Finish Gate
 -> capability-specific adapter
 -> Rust Native Host v1
      one short-lived operation
      framed private stdio
      Windows Job Object / native handles
      suspended -> assign -> resume
      bounded output / timeout / whole-tree cancel
 -> Windows
```

Native Host is execution/evidence only. It does not plan, issue/refresh grants, own WorkingState, decide project PASS/DONE, expose a public shell, run as a daemon or introduce a second policy engine.

## Fresh Stage Research

Added:

`project-context/NATIVE_HOST_V1_RUST_REENTRY.md`

Decision: **NARROW**.

The refresh revalidates current Microsoft Job/handle-inheritance mechanics, Rust 1.98.1, current openai/codex process-tree code and current Goose owner-death tests. It also rebinds the design to the final Core provider seam / exact-grant / quarantine guarantees introduced after #169.

## First implementation slice

Added `runtime/native-host`:

- exact Rust 1.98.1 toolchain selection;
- bounded `u32_be length + UTF-8 JSON` protocol;
- strict Begin/Cancel parsing and field ceilings;
- one Begin per short-lived host;
- no shell command-string API;
- Windows Job Object with `KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE`;
- explicit inherited-handle list through `STARTUPINFOEX`;
- child created suspended, assigned before resume, no uncontained compatibility fallback;
- native Job/process/thread handle ownership;
- stdout/stderr base64 chunk events with per-stream sequence;
- combined output budget and runtime budget;
- root-exit vs tree-quiescence separation;
- whole-tree cancel / owner-EOF cleanup semantics;
- terminal delivery receipts that never claim CAP PASS/DONE;
- focused protocol/unit tests and a real Windows framed E2E smoke.

## Deliberately out of scope

- ConPTY / interactive stdin / resize
- graceful Ctrl-C policy
- sandbox/AppContainer/restricted token
- persistent host/service/daemon
- host durable state, retry queue or scheduler
- cross-platform production parity
- generic local execution / new Chat-facing tool
- direct wiring into an existing capability adapter before the process substrate itself is accepted

## Acceptance status

This PR is Draft. It must not merge merely because hosted CI passes.

Before release-critical acceptance it requires:

1. committed `Cargo.lock` and exact-head hosted Rust/Windows checks;
2. focused/adversarial lifecycle tests, including owner-loss/tree cleanup;
3. fresh independent ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review on exact BASE..HEAD;
4. target-Windows physical Native Host owner-death/process-tree qualification;
5. prerequisite Core physical qualification/merge sequencing handled consistently with `FROZEN_PENDING_PHYSICAL`.

No `EVIDENCE_INDEX.md` row is added before physical evidence actually passes.
